data.body:
AC 1 satisfied. Re-ran the undimensioned-versus-per-ModelId token equivalence over
a fresh ten-day window, 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-25, per region and per metric.
Exactly equal in all eight comparisons, so the undimensioned read is safe to ship
and no escalation is needed.

    us-east-1  InputTokenCount              48,847,172 == 48,847,172
    us-east-1  OutputTokenCount             21,243,452 == 21,243,452
    us-east-1  CacheReadInputTokenCount    783,742,147 == 783,742,147
    us-east-1  CacheWriteInputTokenCount   110,298,792 == 110,298,792
    us-west-2  InputTokenCount                      12 == 12
    us-west-2  OutputTokenCount                      4 == 4
    us-west-2  CacheReadInputTokenCount              0 == 0
    us-west-2  CacheWriteInputTokenCount             0 == 0

This is a different window from the one in the plan (2026-09-14 to 09-24), so it is
an independent confirmation rather than a restatement.

CEILING derived from the trailing 60 days of Cost Explorer as 1.25x the highest
per-token rate per direction, classifying Bedrock rows by the same predicate the
handler will use. The binding model is Claude Opus in every direction — 4.8 for
input and cache-write, 4.7 for output, 4.5 for cache-read — which is the expected
result, since Opus is the priciest family in use. Values go in the code with the
derivation commented beside them; the figures themselves stay out of the tracker
per the machine-local policy.
